description: High-performance, premium university academic result scraper, dashboard analytics portal, and real-time exam publication monitor with automated secure email delivery.

userStories.title: Stealth Connection Pool Core
userStories.description: As a scraper system, I want to establish high-speed keep-alive HTTPS connections to the university portal without external dependencies, so that scans run efficiently without triggering WAF blocks.
acceptanceCriteria: Uses custom KeepAlivePool built on standard library http.client
Implements random UA rotation and cookie synchronization across threads
Enforces global rate-limiting backoffs and stabilization delays on network errors
userStories.notes: Verified resilient connection pooling implemented in scraper_core/network.py

userStories.title: Robust Tag-Agnostic Option & GPA Parser
userStories.description: As a results engine, I want to parsing student details, names, publication dates, GPA/CGPA, and individual subjects from raw HTML, so that diverse exam syllabus schemas are handled.
acceptanceCriteria: Pre-compiles option parsing and regex matching patterns
Extracts SGPA, CGPA, Overall Result, and Publication Date resiliently
Parses tabular subject grades and GP values tag-agnostically
userStories.notes: Tag-agnostic extraction and semester slot calculation complete in scraper_core/parser.py

userStories.title: Profile Persistence & Batch Management
userStories.description: As an administrator, I want to manage student profiles, discover re-adds, and update candidate names, so that student directories are kept synced.
acceptanceCriteria: Loads and saves student profiles under saved_profiles.json
Performs discovery and smart purge of student registries
Stores names, registration numbers, and session variables cleanly

userStories.title: Streamlit Premium UI Analytics Dashboard
userStories.description: As a faculty user, I want a premium and gorgeous analytical web dashboard to run scans, view directories, and query results, so that academic records are visually accessible.
acceptanceCriteria: Applies dynamic custom CSS, premium elevation transitions, and custom Outfit typography
Injects hover-open selectbox javascript actions to eliminate tedious dropdown clicks
Enforces secure admin-mode settings block at the sidebar footer
userStories.notes: Streamlit frontend beautifully constructed in app.py

userStories.title: High-Frequency Real-Time Exam Monitor
userStories.description: As a system service, I want to run lightweight checks every 10 minutes for newly published exams, so that real-time publication alerts can trigger downstream tasks.
acceptanceCriteria: Completes check-only runs in less than 2 seconds
Saves known published exams to database.db / known_exams.json

userStories.title: Email Routing and Jitter Monkeypatching
userStories.description: As a department head, I want to receive secure automated PDF result sheets with dynamic re-add detection, so that faculty results records are kept current without manual downloads.
acceptanceCriteria: Monkeypatches random.uniform in GitHub Actions to bypass long safety delays
Triggers department-specific head email routing via secure environment variables
Applies subject-overlap fingerprinting to merge genuine senior re-adds and exclude ghosts
userStories.notes: Automated reporting pipeline complete in exam_monitor/auto_pdf_mailer.py
